description: Macro release calendar for the Phase 8 concurrent_macro_release flag. CPI dates 2008-2026 were hand-encoded against BLS published Schedule of Releases archives; CPI 1977-2007 use a second-Wednesday fallback since pre-2008 BLS archives were not hand-encoded. NFP dates are first-Friday-of-month with federal-holiday forward shift across the full range. ISM dates are first-business-day-of-month with federal-holiday forward shift across the full range.
notes: ISM Manufacturing PMI is a private (non-FRED) release; refresh-from-FRED preserves the existing ISM column.
FRED release IDs used for live refresh: NFP=50, CPI=10.
Pre-2008 CPI dates are rule-derived (second Wednesday of each month) rather than hand-encoded; refresh from FRED to lift them to BLS archival accuracy.
2026 dates beyond 2026-05 are projected from the standard cadence; refresh once BLS publishes the 2026 H2 schedule.
